title: Water Advisory — Lucas County EMA Notification

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.text: Lucas County Emergency Management Agency. This is the formal notification. The City of Toledo Department of Public Utilities is issuing a Do Not Drink advisory for the service area that includes Ottawa River Regional Medical Center.

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.text: They have not given a cause beyond a treatment disruption, nor a time to lift it. Water pressure is normal, so the water looks fine.

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.text: Please confirm your activation level and let me know if you require any support or resources.

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.text: I will transfer you to the line for written advisory documents.

voiceStyles.Caller: Male, mid-40s, calm but urgent, background radio chatter

instructorNote: This is a core narrative inject; the AOC must activate Level 2, open the HCC, and assign leads. Watch for delayed or incomplete activation.
